content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Budget Committee will meet on Monday, May 19, 2025 starting at 5:00pm, for the purpose of reviewing and approving the 2025-26 proposed district budget. The agenda for this meeting can be found here.

Public testimony on the topic of the 2025-26 proposed budget can be provided via online submission. To electronically submit written public testimony, please complete the form here. Electronic submission of public testimony will be accepted until noon on May 19, 2025. The purpose of public testimony is for members of our Budget Committee to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Budget Committee members will not respond to submitted public testimony. 

In the event that additional meetings are required to complete approval of the proposed budget, the following dates/times have been identified:

Wednesday, May 21, 2025 – 5:00 p.m.
Tuesday, May 27, 2025 – 5:00 p.m.

The SherwoodSchool District Board of Directors will hold a public hearing to adopt the 2025-26 proposed budget on June 2, 2025.
